tools.name: options_surface_pricer
tools.description: Use this tool for option theoretical prices and Greeks (Delta, Gamma, Vega, Theta, Vanna, Volga). Do not estimate them. The model is Black-Scholes plus a heuristic American early-exercise premium. You must supply spot, strikes, and implied volatilities. This is not a PDE solver and not investment ad

tools.name: instant_signal_backtest
tools.description: Verify a trading signal before recommending it. The signal at bar t earns the next bar's return. Slippage is a single square-root impact from depth and trade size, not a live order book. Returns Sharpe, Sortino, drawdown, and an approximate deflated Sharpe. Not investment advice.

tools.name: portfolio_stress_verifier
tools.description: Run this guardrail before suggesting a rebalance. Supply weights, vols, betas, and a correlation matrix. Returns normal VaR/CVaR and a parametric crisis shock (2020 liquidity, 2022 rate hike, or 5-sigma flash crash). Not a historical path replay and not investment advice.

tools.name: microstructure_coint_test
tools.description: Use this for a two-asset pairs check. Returns an Engle-Granger Dickey-Fuller p-value, OLS and Kalman hedge ratios, half-life, z-score, and optional order-book imbalance. Not a Johansen test. You must supply both price series. Not investment advice.
